A hosted workspace is a workspace that Agentivity runs for you. There is nothing to install: you sign up, you get an address, and you work in your browser. Your address looks like `yourname.agentivity.app`.

If you prefer to run Agentivity yourself, see [Install Agentivity with Docker](/docs/getting-started/install-community/).

## What you need

- An e-mail address. You become the owner of the workspace, and the link to open it goes to this address.
- A name for your workspace.

You do not need a card.

## Sign up

1. Open `www.agentivity.io/start`.
2. Under **Plan to try**, choose Personal, Pro or Business.
3. Give **Your email**.
4. Give the **Name of your workspace**. Use 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, with no hyphen at either end. The page shows the address it makes, for example `yourname.agentivity.app`.
5. Accept the terms of use and the privacy policy, and pass the anti-robot check.
6. Select **Start my trial**.

The page then prepares your workspace: it reserves your address, then starts your workspace for the first time. It takes 2 to 5 minutes. Keep the page open.

If the name is already taken, the page says so: choose another. If a trial is already running for your e-mail address, it says so too.

## Open the link and choose your password

When the workspace is ready, the page says "We sent the link to" your address. Open the e-mail and select the link. It works once, and for 7 days.

1. The page says **Welcome aboard.** Check your e-mail, give your name and choose a password.
2. Select **Join**.

You are in the Studio, and you are the owner. The link opens the workspace at its own address: keep it, you will use it every time.

**If you lost the link:** go to `www.agentivity.io/find`, give your e-mail address, and the address and a new link are sent to you. The page answers the same whether or not a workspace exists, so nobody can find out who has one.

**If the link was not used in time,** a trial that nobody opened is removed after 48 hours. Sign up again.

## The 14-day trial

- It lasts 14 days, and starts when you sign up.
- You get every feature of the plan you chose.
- It is limited to 200 executions in all.
- No card is asked, and there is nothing to cancel.

When the trial ends, choose a plan in **Administration** > **Subscription** to keep going: see [Subscription](/docs/administration/subscription/). If you do not, see [A workspace without a plan](/docs/hosted/a-workspace-without-a-plan/): nothing is deleted at once.

## After you sign in

Open the welcome guide, connect an AI model, and try a ready-made solution: see [Welcome guide](/docs/getting-started/welcome-guide/). Invite the people you work with in **Administration** > **People**: see [People, groups, roles and spaces](/docs/administration/people-groups-roles-spaces/).

## Good to know

- The first time, the workspace takes minutes to start. Later, when it has been asleep, it wakes in seconds: see [When your workspace sleeps or is updated](/docs/hosted/sleeping-and-updates/).
- The workspace is yours: the owner can export everything in one file, from **Administration** > **Data**.
